title: NCL Mining Sirdar T&S Gr. C — Mock 12
pattern: NCL Mining Sirdar CBT (100 Q · 100 marks · 90 min · no -ve)

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Operator Training' for heavy equipment in opencast mines must include
options: Certification, familiarization, and regular refresher training
questions.solution: Operator training must include certification and regular refreshers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Success criteria include
options: The number of trucks at the mine
Vegetation, soil stability, water quality, land use
questions.solution: Vegetation, soil, water, land use.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'limitation' section in a report acknowledges
options: The date on which the survey was done
The signature of the manager on the report
Constraints and boundaries of the study or analysis
The letterhead used for the company documents
questions.solution: Limitations acknowledge constraints that may affect the findings or conclusions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A slope monitoring report for opencast mines should include
options: Inclinometer readings, crack measurements, rainfall data, and stability assessments
The speed of the haul trucks
questions.solution: Slope monitoring reports must include instrumentation data, weather, and stability assessments.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Ventilation Plan' under Mines Rules must show
options: The names of the pump operators
The depth of the water sump
The cost of the ventilation fans
Airways, quantities, regulators, and ventilation structures
questions.solution: Ventilation plans must show all airways, air quantities, regulators, and ventilation structures.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Young Person under Mines Act is under
questions.solution: Under 18 years.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Manager under CMR 2017 is
options: The person who purchases the coal
Person appointed by owner to manage the mine
questions.solution: Appointed by owner.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An occupational health report should cover
options: The daily menu of the canteen
The list of workers on leave
Health surveillance data, exposure levels, disease incidence, and medical recommendations
questions.solution: Health reports must cover surveillance data, exposures, disease patterns, and medical recommendations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Blast fragmentation analysis uses
questions.solution: Sieve, image analysis, software.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'bench marking' during mining operations serves to
options: Identify bench levels and boundaries for operational reference
questions.solution: Bench marking identifies levels and boundaries for operational guidance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Mines Act 1952 covers
questions.solution: All mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Blast monitoring equipment includes
options: Seismographs, VOD detectors, air blast monitors
questions.solution: Seismographs, VOD detectors, monitors.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Deck loading with air gaps distributes
options: Energy more evenly along bench height
questions.solution: Energy more evenly along bench height.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'nutrient cycling' in reclaimed ecosystems is important for
options: Long-term soil fertility and ecosystem sustainability
questions.solution: Nutrient cycling maintains long-term soil fertility and ecosystem function.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Mines Rules 1955, 'Explosive Storage' at magazines requires
options: Near the manager's cabin at the surface
Proper ventilation, temperature control, and security measures
questions.solution: Explosive storage requires ventilation, temperature control, and security.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The term 'push loader' in opencast mining refers to
options: A loader that pushes material from behind
questions.solution: A push loader pushes material from behind the excavation face into a collection point.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: DTH hammer drilling is for
questions.solution: Hard rock formations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'post-closure monitoring period' for mines is typically
questions.solution: Post-closure monitoring typically continues for 5-10 years or more.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Stripping ratio increases when
options: Overburden increases or coal price decreases
questions.solution: Thicker overburden or lower price.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Incident Investigation' under CMR 2017 must be
options: A note in the personal diary
Formal investigation of all significant incidents
questions.solution: All significant incidents must be formally investigated.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Maximum dump bench height should not exceed
questions.solution: Generally not exceed 10-15 m.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'principle of equivalent landform' in reclamation means
questions.solution: Equivalent landform means restoring terrain shape and drainage patterns similar to pre-mining conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'bullet point' in reports is used to
options: Present items in a concise, scannable format
questions.solution: Bullet points present information concisely for easy scanning.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Behavioral-based safety (BBS) programs focus on
options: Observing and modifying worker behavior to improve safety
questions.solution: BBS programs use observation and feedback to reinforce safe behaviors and correct unsafe ones.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, a 'Borehole' is defined as
options: A deep narrow hole drilled for prospecting, exploration, or other purposes
questions.solution: Borehole is defined as any deep narrow hole drilled for prospecting, exploration, or related purposes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Working hours should not exceed
questions.solution: 10 hours including overtime.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Safety Record' of a mine under Mines Rules 1955 must include
options: All accidents, near-misses, and safety violations
questions.solution: Safety records must include all accidents, near-misses, and safety violations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Ventilation plan is approved by
questions.solution: The Manager.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Safety committee meetings should be
questions.solution: At least monthly.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Emergency Assembly Point' signage at opencast mines must be
options: Kept open only on the shift days
Clearly visible and accessible from all work areas
questions.solution: Assembly point signage must be visible and accessible.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'explosive factor' in blasting calculations represents
options: Kilograms of explosive per cubic meter or tonne of rock
questions.solution: Explosive factor is the ratio of explosive weight to rock volume or mass.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Safety Training Records' in mines must include
options: Content, attendees, trainer, and assessment results
questions.solution: Training records must include content, attendance, and assessment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Bottom charge is usually
options: Heavier or equal to ensure toe breakage
questions.solution: Heavier or equal for toe breakage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Surface miner cuts
questions.solution: Thin seams without blasting.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Haul road width depends on
questions.solution: Equipment, traffic, safety.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Rescue Station' under Mines Rescue Rules 1985 must have
options: The address book of the staff
Trained rescue personnel and equipment for mine emergencies
questions.solution: Rescue stations must have trained personnel and specialized equipment for mine rescue operations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Workplace inspection under Rules includes
questions.solution: Systematic checking.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Strip mining' is
questions.solution: Opencast mining.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'toe' needs more energy because
options: It is the easiest to break
It is the most confined part
questions.solution: Most confined part.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The mine accident investigation report should include
options: Sequence of events, root causes, recommendations, and corrective actions
questions.solution: Investigation reports must document the event sequence, root causes, and specific corrective actions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'three-point structure' in report writing refers to
questions.solution: The three-point structure is introduction, body, and conclusion for clear report organization.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Mines Rules 1955, 'Competency Certificate' for Overman requires
options: A certificate of the village panchayat
A certificate of the local doctor
Passing prescribed examination and having required experience
questions.solution: Competency certificates require passing examination and meeting experience requirements.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'risk assessment' section in reports identifies
questions.solution: Risk assessment identifies potential risks and proposes mitigation strategies.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Pit expansion requires
options: A fresh coat of paint only
A new fence around the pit
questions.solution: Updated plans and clearances.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Safety Lamp testing is done by
questions.solution: Competent Person.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'defect report' in mining refers to
options: A report on equipment or structural defects found during inspections
questions.solution: Defect reports document equipment, structural, or environmental defects identified during operations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Sub-grade is for
questions.solution: Drainage below seam floor.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Rescue Equipment must be
options: Kept packed in the office only
questions.solution: Maintained ready.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A bench in opencast mining is defined as
options: A horizontal slice of the deposit being worked
questions.solution: A bench is a horizontal division of the working face in openpit mining.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Ammonium nitrate is classified as
questions.solution: Oxidizer in explosive formulations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Topsoil should be
questions.solution: Stored separately.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Reclamation of opencast mines is primarily aimed at
options: Restoring the land to a productive use
questions.solution: The primary goal of reclamation is restoring mined land to a usable, productive condition.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Stemming' confines
questions.solution: Confines explosive energy.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'operating ratio' of a shovel is defined as
options: Actual output divided by theoretical maximum output
questions.solution: Operating ratio measures actual output against theoretical maximum capacity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Owner under CMR 2017 is responsible for
options: Health and safety of all persons
questions.solution: Health and safety of all persons.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'blasting cap' sensitivity requires
options: Careful handling to prevent accidental initiation
questions.solution: Detonators are sensitive and require careful handling.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Bioindicators in reclamation monitoring include
options: Excavators used in the mine workings
The pumps used for dewatering the mine
The drilling machines used at the benches
questions.solution: Bioindicators include plants, invertebrates, and microbes to assess ecosystem recovery.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, 'Working Place' includes
options: All locations where workers are employed or pass through
The store of the mine only
The canteen and the garden only
questions.solution: Working places include all locations where workers are employed or pass.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Spill Berms' at fuel storage areas in opencast mines serve to
options: Contain spills and prevent environmental contamination
questions.solution: Spill berms contain fuel spills and prevent environmental contamination.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'reclamation inspection' during mining ensures
options: Reclamation work meets approved plan specifications
questions.solution: Inspections ensure reclamation work complies with approved plans.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'strike' of a coal seam is the
options: Direction of the line of intersection of the seam with a horizontal plane
Vertical depth of the seam below the surface
Distance between the floor and the roof of the seam
Amount of coal present in the seam
questions.solution: Strike is the horizontal direction of the seam, at right angles to the dip.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Live bottom' is
questions.solution: Active mining area.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'pit dewatering' system design depends on

questions.solution: Dewatering design depends on groundwater conditions, inflow rates, and seasonal patterns.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Ventilation Survey Report includes

Provide fresh air to working faces

questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, the 'Principal Officer' means

The person appointed by the owner as principal officer for compliance
